zh.name: 暗流涌动
zh.subtitle: 最适合第一次完整体验的入门剧本。当前流程示例仍以它作为通用教学基础。

en.name: Trouble Brewing
en.subtitle: The best first full game. The walkthroughs use it as their teaching foundation.

zh.name: No Greater Joy
zh.subtitle: 玩过暗流涌动后的快速进阶剧本。5–6 人小局，角色更少、节奏更快，适合在熟悉基础流程后体验。
zh.notice: 本剧本只有 2 名外来者；6 人局若男爵在场且原本已有 1 名外来者，只会再增加 1 名外来者。

en.name: No Greater Joy
en.subtitle: A faster follow-up after Trouble Brewing, with fewer roles and a brisker pace.
en.notice: This script has only 2 Outsiders. In a 6-player game that already has 1 Outsider, a Baron adds only 1 more.

baron.zh: No Greater Joy 只有 2 名外来者。6 人局原本已有 1 名外来者时，男爵只能再增加 1 名外来者。
baron.en: No Greater Joy has only 2 Outsiders. In a 6-player game that already has 1 Outsider, the Baron can add only 1 more.

zh.name: 7–9人进阶
zh.subtitle: 为已经熟悉暗流涌动的玩家设计：保留基础推理骨架，同时加入死亡干扰、处决保护、延迟击杀与死亡阵营统计。
zh.notice: 推荐 7–9 人、已经玩熟《暗流涌动》的玩家。NEW 标记表示相对《暗流涌动》新增的角色。

en.name: Intermediate 7–9
en.subtitle: Keeps the Trouble Brewing deduction core while adding death interaction, execution protection, delayed kills, and dead-player alignment counts.
en.notice: Recommended after your group is comfortable with Trouble Brewing. NEW marks characters not found in Trouble Brewing.
